title: Stock Market Today, Nov. 17: Stocks Slide on AI Chip and Tech Pressures, Salesforce Plummets 9%
author: Emma Newbery
description: Major stock indexes fell for the fourth consecutive day on November 17, 2026, as AI concerns and technology outages weighed on investor confidence. The S&P 500 dropped 1.03%, the Nasdaq fell 0.74%, and the Dow Jones declined 1.64%. Salesforce plummeted 9.45% amid security concerns and AI replacement fears. However, Nvidia's after-hours earnings beat expectations, offering some reassurance on AI infrastructure demand.

title: Here's What to Expect Ahead of Williams-Sonoma's Q3 Earnings Release
author: Na
description: Williams-Sonoma (WSM) is expected to report Q3 fiscal 2026 earnings of $2.17 per share, up 10.7% year-over-year, with revenues projected at $1.98 billion, growing 5.3%. Growth is supported by digital investments, full-price selling, and supply-chain efficiencies across its portfolio brands including Pottery Barn, West Elm, and Williams Sonoma. The company has a positive Earnings ESP of +2.19% and Zacks Rank of 3, suggesting an earnings beat is likely.

title: Walmart's Q3 Earnings on Deck: Is WMT Stock a Buy or Hold?
author: Na
description: Walmart is set to report Q3 fiscal 2027 results on November 19, with consensus estimates projecting revenues of $186.5 billion (up 3.9%) and EPS of 64 cents (up 3.2%). The Zacks model predicts an earnings beat supported by strong value demand, e-commerce growth, and higher-margin businesses. However, headwinds from pricing investments, pharmacy deflation, and elevated costs may pressure profitability. The stock trades at a premium valuation of 40.78x forward P/E.

title: Should You Buy Costco Stock for Its Special Dividend?
author: David Jagielski, Cpa
description: Costco announced a $30 special dividend, double its previous payout, enticing investors to buy the stock. However, the author argues the stock is overvalued at 54x trailing earnings compared to the S&P 500 average of 23x, making the ~3% dividend return insufficient to justify the purchase given downside risk.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The article advises against buying Costco stock despite the attractive special dividend. The stock is criticized for trading at an inflated valuation of 54x trailing earnings versus the S&P 500 average of 23x. The author warns that the ~3% return from the special dividend is insufficient to offset potential downside risk, and suggests better buying opportunities exist elsewhere.
